Hey, I'm Mahad! 👋

Nice to meet you! I'm a 17-year-old software engineer based in the UK.

I love making cool experiences and technology that people actually like to use.

I'm also a proud member of Hack Club and help run the Newspaper Team there! That includes building infra, working with the community to improve their time at Hack Club, and helping promote the awesome projects that people make.

When I'm not coding, I like reading, music, gaming, and Geocaching when I'm outdoors.

At the moment, it's 6:05 am in the UK (where I live).
